create_MixedPrecisionTrainer: create a MixedPrecisionTrainer to train a PyTorch model using FP16 mixed precision
convert_module_to_f16: convert a PyTorch Conv1d, Conv2d, or Conv3d module's weights and biases to float16
convert_module_to_f32: convert a PyTorch Conv1d, Conv2d, or Conv3d module's weights and biases back to float32
make_master_params: make full-precision master parameters from grouped model parameters for mixed precision training
check_overflow: check if a gradient or parameter value is infinite or NaN during training
